program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16, 10, 22),      # mirror devices (low Vdsat)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid3": (18, 10, 24),      # cascodes (low Vdsat for compliance)
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.25, 2.0),
    "vx":    (0.13, 0.08, 0.22), # target drain voltage of mirror devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vx = p["vx"]
    # mirror pair: identical operating points give identical W, L
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=vx)
    vb = m1.vgs
    # cascodes: source at vx (body effect); reference-side drain at vb, output side at vout
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=max(vb - vx, 0.05), vsb=vx)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=vout - vx, vsb=vx)
    # cascode gate va = vx + VGS3 ; R = (va - vb)/I
    va = vx + m3.vgs
    R = max((va - vb) / I, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.R("R1", "iin", "nb", R)                      # va at node iin, vb at node nb
    n.dev("M3", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)      # reference-side cascode
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)      # reference-side mirror device
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m3)    # output cascode (same size as M3)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)      # output mirror device

    rout = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / (m4.gds * m1.gds) + 1.0 / m4.gds
    vcomp = vx + 0.8 * m4.vdsat
    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": 0.5,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": vcomp,
        "power": 2 * I * 1.8,
    }
